question.text: 0.1 mole of compound ' S ' will weigh _______ g. (Given molar mass in \(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1} \mathrm{C}: 12, \mathrm{H}: 1, \mathrm{O}: 16\))

solution.text: 0.1 mole of compound ( S ) weight in gm $\begin{aligned} & =0.1 \times \text { molar mass of compound }(\mathrm{S}) \\ & =0.1 \times 130=13 \mathrm{gm} \end{aligned}$
